title: NOT BY MIGHT
ZECHARIAH 4:6 PRAYER
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon

scenes.a: If you are trying to force a closed door open today, stop exhausting your own strength.
scenes.sub: NOT BY MIGHT NOR BY POWER

scenes.a: Zechariah four verse six reminds us: Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the Lord of hosts.
scenes.sub: BY MY SPIRIT SAYS THE LORD

scenes.a: Father, at this noon hour, we lay down our striving and the heavy burdens we cannot move on our own.
Where our intellect and hustle fail, fill this room with the quiet, invincible power of your Holy Spirit.
Give us grace to trust your divine timing and breathe peace into our weary hearts.
Subscribe to save this midday prayer, and let us meet God together again tomorrow.
